Jammu and Kashmir CM Meets Tourism and Business Stakeholders

Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah held meetings with representatives from the tourism and business sectors. During these discussions, he assured them of support. The meetings aimed to address concerns and foster collaboration within these key economic areas.
